title.note: Game title kept byte-identical (glossary: keep); Polish players see English Roblox titles as is.
title.blind_remark: left in English, not translated into Polish

hud.reel.note: Imperfective 'keep reeling' (zwijać żyłkę); perfective 'Zwiń' avoided because it is the UI word for Collapse. Same verb as the pass Autozwijanie.

hud.bait_left.note: Label form so 0, 1, 2-4 and 5+ all read correctly (1 przynęta, 2 przynęty, 5 przynęt). Exactly 10 visible characters.

catch.success.note: 'Jest!' is the Polish angler's shout when a fish is landed and replaces gendered 'Złowiłeś/Złowiłaś'. Masculine head noun 'okaz' agrees with the masculine rarity tiers (Rzadki, Mityczny), so the fish name stays in the nominative whatever its gender. Relies on every rarity.* key being the masculine nominative form.

catch.escaped.note: Fishing idiom for a fish slipping off the line; past tense agrees with 'ryba', not the player.

catch.new_record.note: For the developer: {weight} arrives as '12.4'; Polish writes decimals with a comma ('12,4 kg'). Format it per locale in game code.

fish.lantern_eel.note: Species-style name (noun + classifying adjective, like real Polish fish names); 'latarniowy' keeps the lantern idea. 17 of 18.
fish.lantern_eel.blind_remark: the adjective 'latarniowy' is rare and could also read as 'lighthouse' or 'streetlamp' eel

rarity.mythic.note: Masculine nominative, per the guide's rarity rule, so it agrees with 'okaz' in catch.success; reads above Legendarny.

shop.equip.note: Paired with the state label 'W użyciu'; avoids 'Wyposaż', which sounds like gear menus in RPGs, and any participle agreement.

shop.equipped.note: 'In use' state label; no gender agreement needed.

shop.buy_robux.note: Glossary keeps 'Robux' byte-identical, so the inflected forms the guide prefers ('Kup za Robuxy: {price}', 'Robuxów') are not allowed. Price-tag form 'Kup: 99 Robux' reads like '99 PLN' rather than an ungrammatical 'za 99 Robux'. If the developer allows inflection, use 'Kup za Robuxy: {price}'.

pass.auto_reel.note: Same verb as hud.reel (zwijać); 'auto' written together as Polish does (autozapis, autoodtwarzanie). Store name in Creator Hub should match.

pass.lucky_bait.text: Przynęta szczęścia podwaja szansę na rzadkie ryby!
pass.lucky_bait.note: Pass name built from the glossary words: przynęta (Bait) + szczęście (luck), head noun first as Polish compounds go. 'rzadkie' is the Rare tier word.

sell.all.note: 13 vs est. 12. 'Sprzedaj wszystko' (17) is the literal; 'Sprzedaj ryby' (sell the fish) means all of them in Polish and is the shortest natural wording. Use 'Sprzedaj wszystko' if the button has room.

sell.done.note: Two label forms so count = 1 and coins = 1 stay grammatical (1 ryba/12 ryb, 1 moneta/340 monet). Present 'Dostajesz' avoids gendered past 'Sprzedałeś/Sprzedałaś'.
sell.done.review_reason: "Dostajesz monety: {coins}!" chains a verb onto a label form and reads like a form; "Monety: +{coins}!" is the plural-safe reward readout players know from games.

sell.prompt.note: 20 of 21; 'Wciśnij E, by sprzedać' (22) would overflow by one.

ascend.button.note: Prestige mechanic word Polish gamers know (Call of Duty PL); 'Wznieś się' reads like flying or spiritual rising. Noun as button, like the guide's 'Rebirth'.

ascend.confirm.text: Zdobyć prestiż teraz? Zaczniesz od nowa, ale będziesz łowić rzadkie ryby o {bonus}% częściej.
ascend.confirm.note: Infinitive yes/no question as Roblox writes them; 'zdobyć prestiż' is a natural collocation and repeats the button word. 'Zaczniesz' and 'będziesz łowić' have no gender.

weather.storm.note: 'Ryby biorą' is the standard Polish phrase for fish biting.

quest.catch_n.note: Label form so n = 1 works (1 rybę, 5 ryb). Moonlit Bay translated (glossary) as 'Księżycowa Zatoka', here in the locative.

friends.boost.text: Łowienie ze znajomymi daje +{percent}% do szczęścia
friends.boost.note: '+10% do szczęścia' is the usual Polish stat-bonus phrasing ('+5 do siły'); no plural issue after %.

trade.sent.note: Restructured so {player} is the subject in the nominative; 'wysłano prośbę do gracza {player}' is 35 and over budget, 'do {player}' would need the genitive.
trade.sent.review_reason: The sender's confirmation became third-person narration ("{player} is getting a trade request") that no longer says you sent it; impersonal "Wysłano" keeps "sent", has no gender and leaves {player} in the nominative label slot (26 of 33).

trade.accept.note: Present tense as a live announcement; past 'zaakceptował/zaakceptowała' would assume a gender.

codes.redeemed.note: 'Zrealizować kod' is the standard redeem verb in Polish stores (Steam, Xbox).

afk.kicked.text: Zbyt długo bez aktywności, więc łowienie zostało przerwane.
afk.kicked.note: Noun phrase avoids gendered 'Byłeś nieaktywny/Byłaś nieaktywna'; fishing stopping is impersonal. No mention of a kick, as in the source.
afk.kicked.review_reason: "łowienie się zatrzymało" treats the player's fishing like a machine stopping on its own; "łowienie zostało przerwane" is the natural way to say the game stopped it.

event.ends.note: For the developer: '2d 4h' is readable in Polish, but Polish writes '2 d 4 h' and minutes must be 'min', never 'm' (metres).

daily.streak.text: Seria: dzień {day}! Wróć jutro po więcej.
daily.streak.note: Label form 'Seria: dzień 3' works for day 1; 'seria' is the streak word Polish apps use (Duolingo).

tip.night.text: Wskazówka: niektóre ryby biorą tylko w nocy.

group.join.text: Dołącz do społeczności i odbierz 50 darmowych przynęt!
group.join.note: 'społeczność' per Roblox's Groups -> Communities rename in its Polish UI. Fixed 50 takes the genitive plural 'przynęt'.

leaderboard.biggest.note: 'Okaz' is the angler's word for a trophy fish and matches catch.success; plural because the board ranks many players' best fish. 'Najcięższe ryby' (heaviest fish) if the weight sense must be explicit.
